title: Exhausted clock dispatches to completion
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Turing machine with Boolean symbols, and let $x$ and $y$ be Boolean words. For any configuration $c$ of $M$ on input $y$, Boolean tag $b$, function $n$ assigning a natural number to each of the recorder’s counter fields, Boolean word $record$, and natural number $T$, one step of the recorder from its clock-test control, with clock time $T$, produces its completion control configuration, preserving $c$, $n$, $record$, and $T$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite-state Turing machine over Boolean symbols
$c$ is a configuration of $M$ on input $y$
$n$ assigns a natural number to each recorder counter field
replaced: For every source configuration, tag, movement counts, record, and clock budget $T$, one recorder step from the clock-test phase at logical time $T$ reads the exhausted clock blank and yields the completed live control, silently; no further source transition can occur.
